name: singlet_normalization_variance_stabilizing_transform
title: Variance-stabilizing transform
description: Transforms raw UMI counts into a variance-stabilised cells-by-genes matrix for PCA, neighbour graphs and clustering. The default method is shifted_log (scanpy rule: median target sum, then log1p); acosh is the closed-form gamma-Poisson delta-method transform, and analytic_pearson, sctransform_v2 and glmgampoi_pearson write Pearson residuals. Needs UMI integers in layers/counts and optionally obs/size_factors; writes layers/vst_* members, var/vst_overdispersion and uns/vst_settings, and never modifies counts. Do not use on read counts, on already normalised values, or to choose a method by agreement with labels that will score the result.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Transform: shifted_log (default), shifted_log_overdispersion, acosh, or Pearson residuals via analytic_pearson, sctransform_v2 or glmgampoi_pearson. Outputs differ by method.

overdispersion.description: Overdispersion alpha for acosh, shifted_log_overdispersion and glmgampoi_pearson: a fixed value (0 gives Poisson), 'estimate' (per gene, shrunk), or a models/<name> prior.

gene_subset.description: Genes to write, by name. Null writes all genes for sparse outputs and genes detected in at least min_cells cells for residual methods.

target_sum.description: Per-cell total that counts are scaled to when obs/size_factors is absent. Null uses the median of non-zero cell totals.

pseudo_count.description: Pseudo-count y0 of shifted_log, written as log(1 + x/y0) so that zeros stay zero. Ignored by shifted_log_overdispersion.

divisor.description: shifted_log_overdispersion only: pseudo-count is 1/(divisor*alpha). 4 reproduces transformGamPoi; 2 is the first-order asymptote of acosh.

theta.description: Shared negative binomial size, so that alpha = 1/theta.

clip.description: Symmetric clipping bound for residuals. Null means the square root of the number of cells.

min_cells.description: Genes detected in fewer cells than this are dropped from the residual output.

n_genes.description: Genes used to fit and regularise the per-gene parameters.

n_cells.description: Cells subsampled (see seed) to fit the per-gene parameters.

latent_var.description: Obs columns used as depth covariates; log_umi is log10 of obs/total_counts, computed when absent.

batch_var.description: Obs column used as batch covariate. Null means no batch term.

clip.description: Symmetric clipping bound for residuals. Null means the square root of the number of cells.

min_cells.description: Genes detected in fewer cells than this are dropped from the residual output.

clip.description: Symmetric clipping bound for residuals. Null means the square root of the number of cells.

min_cells.description: Genes detected in fewer cells than this are dropped from the residual output.

device.description: Execution device; auto selects CUDA only for methods whose CUDA output matches the CPU reference within the registry tolerance.

seed.description: Random seed for the cell subsample of sctransform_v2; other methods are deterministic.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory, device and output size without writing.

overwrite.description: Replace the output members this tool writes; never replaces the counts layer.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example layers/vst_acosh or layers/pearson_residuals. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, overdispersion_mode and value, n_cells, n_genes_out, nnz_fraction_before, nnz_fraction_after, zero_mapped_to_zero, residual_variance_median and clipped_fraction (residual methods), size_factor_source, ignored_parameters, device_used. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device and, for dense outputs, output_bytes.
